summary: Reviewed 4 files (appsettings.json, FfmpegToolOptions.cs, FfmpegProvisioningOptions.cs, FfmpegManifestOptionsTests.cs). 0 Critical, 0 High, 1 Medium (A08 SHA-256 placeholder integrity gap), 2 Low. Security sign-off: PASS with provisioner hard-fail requirement noted.

comments.note: [Medium] A08 — Software & Data Integrity: SHA-256 values are placeholder strings ('TODO_FILL_AT_IMPLEMENTATION'). Sha256ChecksumVerifier.VerifyAsync will return false with these values (24-char non-hex vs 64-char computed hex). Fail-safe behavior depends on the provisioner hard-failing when VerifyAsync returns false — this is not yet implemented in WP-008 scope. If the provisioner silently continues after a false result, executables would be used without integrity verification, enabling supply-chain substitution. File: appsettings.json. Remediation: (1) provisioner must throw/fail-hard when VerifyAsync returns false — do not fall back to using unverified binaries; (2) validate SHA-256 format is exactly 64 hex characters before calling VerifyAsync, and treat non-conforming values as a configuration error.

[Low] A08 — Supply Chain / Third-party Trust: macOS entries (osx-x64, osx-arm64) source binaries from evermeet.cx, a single-maintainer third-party site with lower organizational trust compared to BtbN/GitHub releases used for Windows/Linux. HTTPS transport is verified; SHA-256 checksum (once filled) provides content integrity. Risk is mitigated by the SHA-256 gate. Remediation: document the explicit trust decision for evermeet.cx as a supply-chain source; verify SHA-256 values against the evermeet.cx site's published checksums when filling values.

[Low] A03/A10 — Config Tampering: Manifest 'Url' values feed into HttpToolDownloader.DownloadAsync (A10/SSRF vector via config modification). 'FfmpegRelativePath' and 'FfprobeRelativePath' values will be Path.Combine'd with the extraction root to locate executables after extraction — path traversal if attacker can write config. Requires filesystem write access to exploit appsettings.json; same privilege level as other local attack vectors. Remediation: at provisioner startup, validate Url scheme is https:// and validate relative paths contain no '..' segments before use.

All URLs use https:// — no cleartext transport. .gitignore correctly excludes tools/ffmpeg/ to prevent committing downloaded binaries. No credentials or secrets in configuration. No new NuGet dependencies in this WP.

comments.note: Fix-Forward applied: ToolManifestEntry.Sha256 doc said 'lower-case hex string' — updated to 'hex string (64 characters); comparison is case-insensitive' for consistency with the IChecksumVerifier.VerifyAsync fix applied during WP-002 review.

The linux-x64 manifest entry uses ArchiveType.TarXz, but WP-004 only delivers ZipArchiveExtractor. The provisioner (WP-007) will need to dispatch to a TarXzArchiveExtractor that does not yet exist. This is an architectural dependency that must be addressed before WP-007 can be completed end-to-end on Linux.

[documentation-forward] The osx-x64 and osx-arm64 manifest entries use a single archive URL from evermeet.cx that is expected to contain both ffmpeg and ffprobe (FfprobeRelativePath and FfmpegRelativePath both set). This assumption should be documented in a comment in appsettings.json or in FfmpegProvisioningOptions, noting that evermeet.cx is the source and that the zip layout must be verified before production.
